# 8. Global Media, Social and Research Sources (16 countries)

[Back to README](../README.md)

How the US midterms are covered in the **10 most populous countries** and the **10 largest economies** (16 countries combined).
Population ranking: India, China, United States, Indonesia, Pakistan, Nigeria, Brazil, Bangladesh, Russia, Ethiopia ([source](https://databoks.katadata.co.id/en/demographics/statistics/6d7538c66b378a7/10-most-populous-countries-in-the-world-october-2026)).
Largest economies (nominal GDP, IMF): United States, China, Germany, Japan, United Kingdom, India, France, Italy, Brazil, Canada (or Russia, depending on IMF edition) ([source](https://spmiasacademy.com/currentaffairs/which-are-the-top-10-economies-in-the-world-by-gdp/)). IMF editions differ at the margin: some list Russia at #9-10 and Canada at #10-11. Both are included here.
